purpose: Office-v5 ESN recovery development; no guarded-rod success substitution
task_gates: Unchanged office PickPlaceTask and placement_complete; all required apparatus contacts and cup stability reported separately and included in strict_success
withheld_policy: Do not simulate or train on withheld layouts before development passes and checkpoint is frozen. Exactly one initial audit per withheld layout, retain failures.
variation_scope: Variant shifts pillar, thick corner and cup by 18mm per unit in world y; seed changes actual ball/cup mass. Drive stroke and initial ball velocity vary. Other unused random fixture fields are not claimed as variations.
no_driven_event_caveat: settle disables initial ball launch and rail strokes only. All obstacles remain physical; gravity and contact may move them.
actor_contract: canonical proprio48/action7; no stage, event clock, geometry, fixture ID or contact truth
horizon_reason: 55s is historical office task horizon and common to all full-task trials. The prior 21s failed run is retained.
failure_policy: Preserve all failures and aborted trials. No gate change, no test recycling labelled blind. Any later protocol version must state cause and preserve this version.
